label: Aristotle, Metaphysics IV.1, 1003a21-26: One inquiry covers every being as being and what belongs…
interpretation: Distributive-scope reading: one inquiry studies every entity insofar as it is being, and the attributes that belong to each such entity in its own right. This represents the passage's universal-scope contrast with particular sciences, while keeping it separate from the formal-object reading and making no claim that being is univocal or that per se means necessity or essence.
